mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the eyes to the nervous system clarified that sight helps locate an object while muscles provide the force to reach.

leastWorthwhile.text: The sequence offered only one combination at each step, so there was little meaningful choice. The final result also mentioned position signals without explaining how they arise.

surprise.text: I had focused on sight guiding the reach; the final result added that signals from the body also report the arm's position.

arbitrary.text: None of the combinations felt purposeless, although the menu supplied the compatible actions and did not ask me to work out the connections myself.

continue.text: I would continue to see how muscles receive their continuing supplies, though I hope the next chapter offers more decisions and explains the processes in enough detail for students to follow.
